limitations: October2026 as-filed prepared statements and notes, not all companies/history or a live feed.
Numeric/text rows retain taxonomy, period, unit/language, dimension hash, co-registrant, precision, duration and footnote context; they are not unique comparable facts.
Dimension, calculation and presentation tables are retained; no silent company-wide aggregation.
Text is retained privately as untrusted source data, not rendered HTML or interpreted instructions.
Missing source taxonomy definitions are retained and explicitly flagged, never invented, dropped or qualified.
No acquisition, legal allegation, outcome, financial recommendation or trading eligibility is inferred from note text.
Exact browser download time and HTTP status unavailable; local verification time is not first-public evidence.
